environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway (REST API, no additional managed rules). The KMS key (alias/session-token-key) is a standard AWS KMS symmetric key (AWS_KMS origin). The Lambda function has kms:Decrypt permission on the key. The encrypted data key is stored in an environment variable. API Gateway passes all requests directly to Lambda with no rate limiting or response transformation. CloudWatch logs are enabled but no alerting is configured.
